requirements.desc: When final-regression starts a discovered regression command, stderr shows the command string before the child process starts while stdout remains reserved for the final JSON envelope.
When final-regression starts, stderr shows the repo-relative raw log path before the child process starts while stdout remains reserved for the final JSON envelope.
While the final-regression child process is running, elapsed time output is emitted to stderr every 30 seconds until the process exits or reports a spawn error.

When final-regression fails after artifact paths have been created, including process attempts, discovery errors, and worktree root mismatch, stderr includes both final-regression-result.json and the raw log path.
The existing final-regression result artifact schema, raw log artifact path, failureKind classification, nextAction, retryable flag, and success/failure envelope semantics remain unchanged.

advisoryFindings.title: Default heartbeat interval not pinned
advisoryFindings.improvement: Add a focused assertion or design note covering that the production default heartbeat interval remains 30000 ms while keeping the executable test fast through the existing override.
advisoryFindings.whyNonBlocking: The current test exercises heartbeat emission while the child is running and avoids a slow 30-second test, so requirement behavior is materially covered; the exact default interval is the only unpinned detail.
